cases.description: full-rank isotropic noise in 1158 columns, no latent structure; no neighbourhood estimator can reach 1158 at n=2000, so what is asserted is separation from cases 1 and 2 and what is recorded is this estimator's empirical ceiling

cases.description: 200 latents, random linear map into 1158 columns, the same construction as case 1. CALIBRATION ONLY: 200 sits inside the range the real participation ratios occupy, and n=2000 points cannot fill a 200-dimensional manifold, so recovery is not expected and is not asserted. The ratio to truth is what this case exists to record.

correlation_dimension.window_spec: percentiles 10.0-30.0 of the pairwise distance distribution, fixed for every dataset

step0_synthetic_gate.calibration_note: Cases 4 and 5 put known linear dimensions [200, 450] inside the range the real participation ratios occupy. They are NOT gated on recovery: 2000 points cannot fill a manifold of those dimensions, so under-recovery is expected and its size is the measurement. Read a real-data estimate near case 3's empirical ceiling as possibly censored rather than measured.

calibration_inversion.exclusion_reason: d = 10 is excluded from the fit. There the estimator is nearly unbiased and the estimate-to-truth relation is not the one that holds in the censoring regime the anchors sample. The inversion does NOT extend to it and must not be applied there.
calibration_inversion.form: d_true = A * estimate ** B, exact through the two anchors

config.rank_int_excluded: deliberate: not an admissible preprocessing arm for these data
